# Security / 安全问题反馈

Please report vulnerabilities through [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/Fleve-MY/DexLink/security/advisories/new). Include the affected version, environment, impact, and reproduction steps. Remove credentials, personal files, and unrelated device identifiers.

安全漏洞请通过 [GitHub 私密漏洞报告](https://github.com/Fleve-MY/DexLink/security/advisories/new) 提交，并提供受影响版本、环境、影响与复现步骤。请删除凭据、个人文件和无关设备信息。

The initial preview is intended for trusted local networks. LAN bridge pairing and unified authorization remain incomplete, and video is unencrypted. Keep the service off public networks.

首个预览版本面向可信局域网，局域网桥接入口的设备配对与统一授权仍待完善，视频传输未加密。请将服务保持在可信网络内。

Security fixes target the latest published preview. Older previews have no separate maintenance branch.
